content_text:
Are you interested in a specific genre? You could either write a simple script on a good story (and in my case it’s been the hardest part)  or, as an exercise, trying to reproduce a shot from a movie you like (lights and vfx apart).
Besides that, are you going to shot a scene? You’ll need actors and you’ll Need to be a director too . 😉 And perhaps some kind of lights to begin thinking as a cinematographer.
And to organize everything you Need to be a producer too, ah ah!
